title: RNA Extraction with PGTX
author: Lutz LCB Berwanger
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ywwfxfe
materials: Let the samples incubate for 10 min at room temperature in a Thermomixer. Vortex from time to time. 00:10:00

steps.title: Harvest Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Collect the bacterial cell pellet from the liquid culture.

substeps.instruction: Fill a 50 mL Falcon tube with ice and add bacterial liquid culture up to a volume of ~45 mL.
Centrifuge for 3 minutes at 4˚C and 4,000 g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in the residual water (~1 mL).
Transfer the suspension to a 2 mL 'safe lock' tube.

steps.title: Lysis and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cells in PGTX and store if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 ml of PGTX.
Freeze in liquid nitrogen and store at -20 ˚C.

steps.title: Thermal Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample to facilitate lysis.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 5 min at 95 °C, shaking at 250 rpm in a Thermomixer (Eppendorf).

steps.title: First Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the RNA from proteins and lipids using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µl Chloroform.
Centrifuge for 15 min at 14,000 g and 4 ˚C.

steps.title: Second Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Further purify the aqueous phase using Aqua-P/C/I.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (containing RNA) to a fresh reaction tube.
Add the same volume (450 µL) of Aqua-P/C/I (Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamylalcohol).
Thoroughly mix by vortexing.
Centrifuge for 15 min at high speed.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a 1.5 mL reaction tube.
Add 1 volume of isopropanol.
Mix and incubate for at least 30 min at -20 ˚C (can be left overnight).
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 30 min.

steps.title: RNA Washing
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet to remove residual salts and solvents.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 75% chilled ethanol (Ethyl alcohol, Pure 200 proof, for molecular biology Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #E7023), avoiding resuspension of the pellet.
Centrifuge at 14,000 g for 5 minutes.
Repeat the washing step with 75% chilled ethanol.
Remove excess EtOH using a pipet.

steps.title: Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend in water.

substeps.instruction: Air dry the pellet at RT for 10 minutes (do not overdry).
Resuspend the pellet in 30 µL of ddH2O (or usually 40 µL DECP-treated H2O).
